title: Hausdorff measure on the span of an orthonormal frame
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, τ : Fin n → ℝ^P orthonormal, Q := span τ ⊆ ℝ^P, Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^P, and ι(a) := Σ_i a_i τ_i for a ∈ ℝⁿ = Eucl n, with Lebesgue measure da = volume on ℝⁿ. Then (i) ∫_Q h dHⁿ = ∫_{ℝⁿ} h(ι(a)) da for every function h : ℝ^P → ℝ, and (ii) (Hⁿ⌞Q)(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (τ : Fin n → Eucl P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → (∀ h : Eucl P → ℝ, ∫ z in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Eucl P)), h z ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) = ∫ a : Eucl n, h (∑ i, a i • τ i)) ∧ ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Eucl P))) K < ∞
